title: narcissus × rugulosus
intro: Narcissus × rugulosus, commonly known as the miniature daffodil, is a type of hybrid flowering plant belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Narcissus × rugulosus include its ability to reduce anxiety, improve mood, and alleviate symptoms of depression, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of sedation and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents present in Narcissus × rugulosus include alkaloids such as galantamine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, and other compounds like nuciferine and pseudogalantamine, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
